Survey Technician

Australia, Queensland, Mooloolaba

Experience: Not applicable

Infrastructure

Introduction

What are you going to do

  • Prepare, maintain and update survey models, set out data and GPS files.
  • Upload and manage survey data across survey instruments and machine control systems.
  • Coordinate survey set out to support construction activities and project delivery.
  • Review drawings and specifications to ensure survey accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain survey equipment registers and software updates.
  • Support project teams by providing accurate survey information and technical assistance.
  • Ensure survey activities are completed in accordance with project specifications and quality standards.

Essential skills and knowledge 

  • Previous experience as a Survey Technician within the civil construction industry.
  • A qualification in Surveying, Spatial Science or a related discipline (or working towards).
  • Experience using GPS survey equipment and machine control technology.
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent planning and organisational skills.
  • The ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative project team.
  • A current Australian Driver Licence.

What we offer

  • Long-term pipeline of secured civil infrastructure projects.
  • Competitive salary + super + fully maintained vehicle
  • Diverse projects across civil infrastructure, urban development and subdivisions

About Brunel:

Brunel is a recruitment and flexible workforce solution provider which connects talented people with opportunities throughout Australasia and around the world. We specialise in highly skilled roles across a variety of technical, professional, trades and craft disciplines, pairing candidates with industry-leading projects and organisations on a contract, permanent or secondment basis.

Operating in Australasia since 1997, Brunel has major bases of operation in Perth, Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne and Port Moresby, which are further backed by the strength and reach of a truly global network spanning over 45 countries, 120 offices and 50 years of successful operation.

Brunel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander and female candidates.

Do you have questions?

If you have any questions or would like to discuss the details of this role, please contact Laine at l.thornton@brunel.net or 0413 630 160.

Our Culture and Values

At Brunel, we are proud of our unique corporate culture, which is shaped and nurtured by the collective efforts of our employees. Our work environment is characterised by an authentic, communicative and inclusive approach to teamwork that fosters an atmosphere of collaboration and creativity. Our values are at the center of everything we do – for our clients, our colleagues and ourselves.

Learn more about our global network of specialists!

Our ESG Commitment

Since 1975, our mission has always been to connect specialists to exciting career opportunities, to support the development of these careers, and to offer fair and equal employment. This has enabled us to create a truly sustainable and durable business model. Having a passion for people and caring deeply for the environment is not only part of Brunel’s DNA but is also reflected in our culture and values. As a global company, we take our social responsibility very seriously.

Join us on our mission!
